name: After § 121
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 121h. Notes the Commission’s proposal for the taxation of large multinational corporations (the ‘CORE tax’); regrets that this proposal is grossly insufficient to ensure a genuine corporate contribution to European public finances, as even the Commissioner for Budget, Anti-Fraud and Public Administration, Piotr Serafin, acknowledged that ‘it will only affect the very largest companies on a level comparable to a typical annual bonus of the CEO in such a company’; notes that the proposed contribution will amount to a maximum of 0.1 % of turnover and, most strikingly, will be capped at EUR 750 000, irrespective of the size of the corporate group; observes that, for example, TotalEnergies would therefore pay a tax of EUR 750 000, representing a mere 0.000567 % of its EU turnover, highlighting the inadequacy of the measure; deplores the fact that certain Member States, including France, have opposed this CORE tax; calls on the Commission to substantially revise its CORE tax proposal to ensure meaningful and proportionate contributions from large corporations according to their real economic presence and profits within the EU;
